item.title: The Five Minute Read
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.

item.title: Friday’s high school roundup: Westford Academy bounces Newton North from tourney
item.description: Guided by Kaitlyn Pepin and Phoenix Philbrick, the Westford Academy girls basketball team advanced in the Div. 1 state tournament with a 64-50 win over fellow Dual County League member Newton North on Friday night. item.title: Hopeful Thinking: Humanity is in retrograde
item.description: It can feel, at times, as though humanity itself is in retrograde — appearing to move backward instead of forward, circling the same old conflicts, rehearsing the same arguments, mistaking noise for progress.
